'''Arikem''' is an extinct [[Tupian languages|Tupian language]] of the state of [[Rondônia]], in the Amazon region of [[Brazil]], formerly spoken by the {{Interlanguage link|Arikem people|pt|Ariquéns}}. It had many foreign influences, and was once incorrectly classified as [[Chapacuran languages|Chapacuran]]. The Arikem called themselves {{Lang|ait|Ahopovo}}; the name "Arikem" comes from the [[Urupa language]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Onofrio |first=Jan |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=IGzgCQAAQBAJ&dq=rondon+Arik%C3%A9m&pg=PA103 |title=Dictionary of Indian Tribes of the Americas |date=1995-01-01 |publisher=American Indian Publishers, Inc. |isbn=978-0-937862-28-5 |pages=102–103 |language=en}}</ref>
